answer: Each submission hangs on the canyon of a task receipt, and the echo is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, rewards vest against future work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. By the falcon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
